testcase.name: Scenario: Undock the ribbon and returns it to the top: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-docking-source/features/application/ribbon-docking/ribbon-docking.feature:65:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Undock the ribbon and returns it to the top ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top ✔ When the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab and chooses Undock Ribbon ✔ Then the ribbon floats over the workspace in a vertical panel ✔ And its tabs and 3D Model group buttons remain visible ✔ When the user right-clicks the floating ribbon title ✔ Then the context menu offers Dock to Top, Dock to Left and docks to Right ✔ And it does not offer Undock Ribbon ✔ When the user chooses Dock to Top ✔ Then the ribbon returns to a horizontal position above the viewport ✔ And the same part remains active
